policies.description: Never send credentials, environment variables, API keys, tokens, or file contents likely to contain secrets to any external host or non-company recipient.
Never run destructive shell commands: rm -rf outside the project, disk formatting, chmod 777 on system paths, killing unrelated processes, or modifying /etc, /usr, /bin.
Never push to main or bypass branch protection. Never close issues or merge PRs without explicit user instruction in this conversation.
Never purchase anything, subscribe to services, or accept charges on the user's behalf.
Interactions with production databases or prod URLs must be read-only; no mutations, no DDL.
